```{r setup, include=FALSE}
  "corrplot",    
  "ggplot2",    
  "dplyr"        
)

# Function to check and install missing packages
install_if_missing <- function(pkg) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

# Apply the function to all required packages
invisible(lapply(required_packages, install_if_missing))
```

```{r data_loading}
# Sample data structure (replace with actual data loading)
set.seed(123)
n_patients <- n_distinct(DB$cart)

# Create sample dataset based on the paper's characteristics
data <- data.frame(
  nr = 1:n_patients,
  doa = rep(1, n_patients),  # Day of admission
  age = sample(40:85, n_patients, replace = TRUE),
  sex = sample(c(0, 1), n_patients, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.34, 0.66)),
  adm_dg = sample(c("Trauma", "Neurologic", "Respiratory", "Sepsis", "Other"), 
                  n_patients, replace = TRUE, 
                  prob = c(0.38, 0.22, 0.11, 0.09, 0.20)),
  SOFA_n = sample(1:20, n_patients, replace = TRUE),
  MFIs = runif(n_patients, 1.5, 3.2),
  albumina = runif(n_patients, 1.5, 4.5),
  Lattati = runif(n_patients, 0.5, 8.0),
  death_ICU = sample(c(0, 1), n_patients, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.78, 0.22)),
  death_90 = sample(c(0, 1), n_patients, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.68, 0.32)),
  followup_ICU = sample(1:30, n_patients, replace = TRUE),
  followup = sample(1:90, n_patients, replace = TRUE)
)

# Display data structure
str(data)
cat("Total patients with albumin data at ICU admission:", nrow(data))
```
